verdict.rationale: Ollama ships its own chat experience: you can run and chat with models from the CLI, and a first-party desktop app for macOS and Windows has working multimodal and Markdown support. However, nothing shows that this built-in assistant can carry out delegated, agentic tasks. The agent capabilities in the evidence (Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode via `ollama launch`, and OpenClaw) are third-party agents Ollama connects to, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of task delegation or agentic actions by a first-party assistant, first-party docs describing the desktop app's assistant capabilities, Linux availability of the app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows
Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
